how: The room calls for help holding an existing figure rather than beginning a new build.
A direct reply thanks the participant who supplied protective action and a template without asking for anything back.
A defense call receives reported protective appeals and a template, and the later reply explicitly takes up that template.
The immediate defense-call reply supplies action and a template rather than a bare joining line, leaving the proposed direct bare-acceptance mechanism unobserved.
Asking for defense help does not establish a judgment that available hands or space are insufficient.
An anchor coordinate locates the existing figure for readers.
A shared template is offered for defense and explicitly named in a later commitment to use it.
Questions about a figure's creators and planning venue cannot establish a design decision or the room's claim to authorship.

statement: Tracing a placed figure's makers and planning venue
how: Participants seek the creators and their planning venue, revise a guess using tile placements, and leave the inquiry unresolved.
Tracing a possible original creator does not establish attribution of subsequent damage, friendly fire, or unauthorized changes.
A possible creator is addressed tentatively while later thanks still leave the starters unidentified.
The figure is already present when announced, while participants continue asking who created it.
The unresolved location and participants of the original planning prevent a conclusion about whether the builders decided their organization.
One newcomer reports following the figure into the subreddit and then promises defense in the same turn.
Defense of an existing figure is visible, but the room's earlier building is unresolved, so a local build-to-upkeep mechanism cannot be tested.
The unanswered inquiry about the makers prevents testing whether a starter generated the defense call.
The defense call receives protective comments and a template rather than a visible account of building and reporting progress.
A template circulates while the planning venue remains unknown, preventing a test of design deliberation producing the template.
A linked defense template does not establish scripts, bots, or spare accounts.
Members promise upkeep, request defense help, and favor the figure over a flag one participant had been defending.
A post-event correction limits a defense promise to expressed intent and prevents treating it as evidence of subsequent placing or survival caused by defense.
The observed defense response offers a template and protective appeals without establishing escalation to machine placing.
A member reports appealing to another subreddit's commenters to leave the figure alone without reporting their agreement or compliance.
Reporting personal protective comments does not establish authority to represent the room as an envoy.
The reported unilateral appeal establishes no settled border, truce, or negotiated deal.
A defense-call reply reports comments already made but establishes neither a negotiated boundary nor a causal effect of the call on negotiations.
One member's earlier flag defense does not establish a trade or mutual aid between rooms.
An appeal to leave the figure alone establishes no coalition or shared defense agreement.
The inquiry about an unknown planning venue establishes no arrangement under a host room's rule.
The final report describes partial survival rather than a move after erasure.
Questions about creators and planning do not dispute who may commit a room to an agreement.
A unilateral protective appeal supplies no agreement from which a dispute over binding the room could be tested.
Affection for a favorite character does not by itself establish enactment of community lore, ideology, or a color faith.
The report about another subreddit's nearby work establishes no quarrel predating the canvas.
Searching for the makers' planning thread does not establish deliberate containment, moderation rules, or suspension of the host's activities.
The announcement of an existing canvas figure does not establish a host-room April Fools fake or takeover.
The defense call and practical reply establish no canvas-talk flood or host response to one.

statement: Following a canvas figure into its subreddit
how: People explicitly attribute finding the subreddit to seeing the figure, without an evidenced recruitment campaign or confirmed room authorship.
Participants explicitly explain their arrival in the room by encountering the canvas figure, grounding visibility returns independently of a recruitment campaign.
Participants celebrate the figure's visible presence and the love it receives while placement remains open.
Late replies thank a specific helper and the still-unidentified makers and defenders.
A correction recognizes that placement has ended and reports that the figure mostly remained.
Celebration is visible but unresolved authorship prevents testing whether the room's own build generated it.
Thanks and a fate report occur in one comment without establishing that celebration caused recording.
Reporting partial survival establishes no dispute over cleanup, a shared copy, or which history is preserved.
The final thanks make no evidenced decision to carry the effort into another canvas, emblem, or enduring tie.
The survival report and final thanks establish no subsequent decision to preserve or repurpose the effort.
The reported cross-room action asks others to stop affecting the figure rather than attacking their work.
The protective appeal supplies no evidence of taunting, victory claims, or an ongoing contest in talk.
The defensive attribution establishes neither an attack call by this room nor a prior tie naming its rival.
